title: Deployed-artifact DNS/HTTPS route fixes: Cloudflare ownership marker, DNS ContextVM availability, unit-aware reconcile runtime
intended_behavior: Cloudflare DNS record comments are a deterministic bounded ownership marker 'bahia:<sha256hex(source_coordinate)>' (70 chars, provider limit 100); the signed plan's source_coordinate and desired-state hash are unchanged.

dns/* ContextVM methods are always registered; when dns.enabled is false they return JSON-RPC -32000 'DNS orchestration is not enabled; set dns.enabled and configure a backend' instead of method-not-found.
dns.backends type 'filesystem' is rejected at config validation (no operational activator is wired) instead of failing startup health obscurely.

Scheduled reconcile resolves runtime through the explicit deployment unit (unit runtime type authoritative), eliminating false runtime-type conflicts for services whose metadata differs from their unit; transient unit-load errors skip the cycle, deleted units fall back to legacy resolution with a warning.
